draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 223rd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 31st of 37 at CB. He went 240th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 7 passes defended in 2021, 8th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2023. 30 career games and 2 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2022. Weak spots: season snap share 2.8% (7th percentile), approximate value 1 (17th percentile).
